integration_issues.issue: RNGH gesture handlers do not respond to Playwright mouse events in Expo web. Mouse drag simulation (mousedown+mousemove+mouseup) does not trigger panGesture.onStart/onUpdate/onEnd. Soup stays in slot 0 after mouse drag simulation.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: renderSoupInSlot previously used hasSoup = soupSlot === slotIdx && !soupDragging, which returned false when soupDragging=true, unmounting GestureDetector mid-drag. RNGH lost the gesture context so onUpdate/onEnd never fired, freezing the soup. Fix: remove !soupDragging from condition so GestureDetector remains mounted for the entire drag lifecycle. Image separately hidden via {!soupDragging && <Image/>}. Fix is correct and present in code.
